knowledgeAnswers.rationale: The lesson says to withdraw to a safe location, secure only what can be secured without exposure, and notify the supervisor. The worked example isolates the worker and asks for specialist assessment.
The lesson says resumption happens only after the responsible person confirms the hazard is controlled and the plan is safe.
The lesson says to record time and facts without naming uninvolved clients or speculating about causes.
The safe operating procedure says to pause when new people, equipment, weather, contamination, aggression or access restrictions change the job.

practicalCriteria: Learner stops a supplied simulated task when a condition changes, and states who could be harmed and how.
Learner chooses a control for the changed condition and checks that it is in place before continuing.
Learner raises a simulated pressure to hurry, stops the unsafe work and records the stop with the cause and the person notified.
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
evidenceRequired: Record of each stop, with the condition, decision and person notified
Record of any method change approved after a stop
stopWorkCriteria: Learner continues an unsafe task because of time pressure
Learner improvises a method when the procedure cannot be followed
